user.title: BToddB Notifications
user.description: Pick the default notify service the send action pushes to.

data_description.notify_service: Pick the notify service to push notifications to by default (e.g. notify.persistent_notification, notify.mobile_app_DEVICE, or a notify group). Individual calls to btoddb_notifications.send may override this with target.

send.name: Send notification
send.description: Push a high-priority notification through the configured (or overridden) notify target.

title.name: Title
title.description: Optional notification title. Omitted from the payload if not given.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Android notification channel name. Defaults to "BToddB Notifications".

tag.description: Notification tag for de-duplication/replacement. HA Companion app only.

actions.name: Actions
actions.description: List of actionable-notification buttons, each with action and title. HA Companion app only.

target.name: Target
target.description: "domain.service" override of the configured default notify target for this call only.
